final99Boundary.note: Final-99 was executed against production 6a95c23f before later evidence-only refreshes; this launch audit smoke was executed after production advanced to 6158d2c0.

uiArchitectureBoundary.acceptedStructure: step split plus first-viewport cockpit plus bounded drilldown/detail panes

documentsDefaultCockpit.detail: Default Documents cockpit raw page height and overflow are no longer the primary blocker in current live evidence.

documentsSelectedEditorDetail.closed: First meaningful field summary / risk-row landing is accepted when it intersects the visible viewport or bounded pane immediately.
documentsSelectedEditorDetail.open: Raw textarea and full long-form document authoring remain secondary drilldown/readability debt and should not be described as a short editor surface.

shareDesktop.closed: Current raw geometry is two-column and not a literal mobile stack.
shareDesktop.open: If reproduced in a user-visible session, perceived narrow-card/full-workbench composition should be handled as a visual IA follow-up rather than a page-count fix.

shareMobile.detail: Mobile Share keeps selected summary, bounded preview, primary CTA, and collapsed details inside the current first-viewport contract.

nextAcceptance: Do not use page count alone as a UX fix.
For selected editor/detail work, require first meaningful editable content or field summary to intersect the visible viewport or bounded pane immediately.
For Share desktop perception follow-up, measure deliberate workbench breadth/x-ranges, preview/form balance, horizontal overflow, and first CTA/status/result y positions.
